LESSON: THE LOST SHEEP

Grade: Grade 8
Subject: CHRISTIAN RELIGIOUS EDUCATION
Strand: Teachings of Jesus Christ
Topic 4.2: The Lost Sheep
Suggested lessons in curriculum: 7

SECTION 1: INTRODUCTION

This lesson covers The Lost Sheep, part of Teachings of Jesus Christ in Grade 8 CHRISTIAN RELIGIOUS EDUCATION.

Key inquiry question: How does the parable of the lost sheep portray God’s love for the sinner?

You will study the official KICD learning outcomes, classroom activities, values, and competencies for this topic. Use Kenyan examples from your county, school, and community throughout.

SECTION 2: LEARNING OUTCOMES

By the end of this topic, you should be able to:

Refer to the KICD curriculum reference at the end of this lesson for the full list of outcomes.

SECTION 3: KEY CONCEPTS AND EXPLANATION

A. Suggested learning experiences (from KICD)

1. brainstorm on God’s love for the sinner,

2. read Luke 15:1-7 and make notes on the parable of the lost sheep,

3. outline lessons learnt from the parable of the lost sheep,

4. role-play the parable of the lost sheep,

SECTION 4: LEARNING ACTIVITIES

A. At school

1. brainstorm on God’s love for the sinner,
2. read Luke 15:1-7 and make notes on the parable of the lost sheep,
3. outline lessons learnt from the parable of the lost sheep,
4. role-play the parable of the lost sheep,

B. At home with your parent or guardian

1. Read this lesson on The Lost Sheep together.
2. Discuss the key inquiry question and give examples from your area.
3. Write five sentences summarising what you learned.
4. Prepare for the revision quiz at the end of this topic.

SECTION 5: CORE COMPETENCIES, VALUES, AND PCIs

Core Competencies to be developed:
• Citizenship: Active community skills are demonstrated as learners organise a class visit to the less fortunate and donate

items.

• Creativity and Imagination: The skill of making connections is exhibited as learners undertake a task to compose and sing a

song on God’s love for the lost.

Values:
• Love: The learners demonstrate the love of God by reaching out to the lost/sinner.

• Respect: The learners take turns to read various Bible texts and appreciate each other’s opinions during class discussions.

Link to other subjects:

• Creative Arts and Sports: The learners role-play the parable of the lost sheep.

• English: The learners brainstorm on how to reach out to the lost/sinner.
